text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
To fail to produce results after coming 
this far...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Could you share your opinion? What is 
missing, and what is the problem?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...How does it look through your eyes?
choice_data_list:
You're a diamond in the rough, destined to 
grow even stronger.

There's still a mountain of things we can 
do!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...In other words, right now it's still 
just an unpolished stone—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not blaming you. I think you're 
completely right.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Without polishing, it's just an ordinary 
stone. That's why I have no choice but to 
work hard.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I can see what is needed now. Next time... 
I won't lose again.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I don't need a soft environment. I'll 
throw away any naive thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...That's fine. That's why... I can fight.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I will push myself even harder for the 
next one. I look forward to working with 
you."
